caption: The drawing depicts a single oval-shaped, decorative box set against a plain, light-colored background. The lid of the box is rendered in muted shades of cream, green, and pink, displaying a pattern of foliage and possibly floral motifs. The side of the box features a broad band of blue at the top, with the lower part decorated by an elaborate design that combines deep blue, green, and yellow, enveloping a central panel of intricate red and cream ornamentation. The box appears to be made of a material with a smooth, slightly glossy texture, possibly papier-mâché or tin, and is shown without any accompanying objects. The overall color palette includes pale cream, various greens, blues, soft yellows, and reds, with the decoration on the box dominating the image composition.
title: Toilette Box
